title: Ahi! qual dolore
subtitle: Musetta's shoe: Alcindoro sent off, Musetta and Marcello reunited, the bill arrives, La bohème, Act 2

passages.label: Ahi! qual dolore: Musetta's foot hurts (quasi a piacere, E major)
Sciogli, slaccia! Gioventù mia (I.º tempo, the waltz)
Ahi! che fitta: the shoe comes off; La commedia è stupenda
Marcello! Sirena! (a tempo Sostenuto, the waltz in full)
Siamo all'ultima scena: the bill (Meno, ancora più Lento)

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 140-145 (from Musetta's "Ahi! qual dolore", page 140 system 2, to the bar before the Allegro alla marcia on page 145, 29 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. The offstage drums' separate staff (from page 145) is not included. No metronome mark is printed in this passage: the I.º tempo is the waltz's printed ♩ = 104 (page 130); other values chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
